ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (29) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Существующий порядок» (sushchestvuyushchiy poryadok, 'the existing order') and «устройство» (ustroystvo, 'arrangement') are kept distinct; Herzen's «антропофагия» (antropofagiya) stays 'anthropophagy'. Ruskin's «рассудок» (rassudok) is 'intellect', kept apart from «разум» (razum, 'reason'), and attributions follow the print («Джон Рёскин», 'John Ruskin').
